lines.en: I slide across two floor tiles.
A little darker, and I move easier.
Not so fast; I might come apart.
When the wind blows, I lean.

lines.zh: 被驯服后，我话少了很多。
lines.en: Since being tamed, I say very little.
Your heels are my signposts.
I turn where your shadow turns.
I follow you without a sound.
Step by step, I spread upward.
I walk without leaving prints.
Seven steps. I'm right behind you.

lines.zh: 我被驯服了，但还是影子。
lines.en: Tamed, but still a shadow.
I wait for the wick to burn shorter.
Only at night do I have thickness.
In the dark, petals rustle softly.
One stick of incense here lasts a year.
This lamp makes me feel faint.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的影子跟一步
lines.en: One step from you, one from my shadow
I try to grow a face.
I only take shape in the dark.
I flow along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我身上，看不见。
lines.en: Dust settles on me, unseen.
My shape is borrowed from yours.

lines.zh: 你睡了，我就在床边站着。
lines.en: You sleep, and I stand by the bed.
I follow you with very light steps.
The floor is cool; I lie against it.
Don't blink; I fear you won't know me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，影子贴着脚跟。
lines.en: I follow you, my shadow on your heels.

lines.zh: 被你收服的影，贴着脚跟。
lines.en: A tamed shadow, hugging your heels.
I tilt my head the way you do.
What you see is the wall, not me.
I raise a hand; can you see it?
I see you, Tamed Shadow.
Your eyes outline my edges.

lines.zh: 被驯服的影子，看着你的手。
lines.en: The tamed shadow watches your hand.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，影子贴着影子。
lines.en: I follow you, shadow to shadow.
When you look down, I have a face.
My face is only a patch of dark.
You finally looked up and saw me.
I follow you now; don't be afraid.
I keep to your feet and stay quiet.
I lend you my outline to look at.
There is no me in your pupils.

lines.zh: 被驯服的影子，也还是影子。
lines.en: A tamed shadow is still a shadow.
You looked so long, I feel a little warm.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我却在看你身后。
lines.en: You watch me; I watch behind you.
A shadow shrinks when it is struck.
Stop; I am turning transparent.
It hurt so much I nearly left the floor.
I touch your hand. It is warm.
Scattered shadow gathers again.
That blow made me thinner.
A tamed shadow still fears the lamp.
A shadow can hurt. Strange.
The dark felt that ache for me.
My edges are trembling.
Give me a share of what you hold.
Give me a little light — just a little.
That light, is it for me?
The warm breath of something living draws me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，就没有自己的影子了。
lines.en: Following you, I have no shadow of my own.

lines.zh: 这根手指，记得这个形状。
lines.en: This finger remembers that shape.
Just let me touch it once.
It is good for a shadow.
I won't eat it; I only want to press close.
Bright things stop my feet.
You stepped on me, and I slid away.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖穿过了我的胸。
lines.en: Your knee went through my chest.
Don't test me with your foot; I come apart.
I am too thin to make a sound when struck.
Shadow meets shadow, and neither feels pain.
I'm tougher than you think.

lines.zh: 我没重量，你却退了一步。
lines.en: I have no weight, yet you stepped back.
You touched me and felt a chill, right?

lines.zh: 我这影子被你撞得晃了一下。
lines.en: Your bump made my shadow waver.
I circle close around your feet.
The dark is big enough for two.

lines.zh: 我们贴着墙，谁也不出声。
lines.en: We press to the wall, neither making a sound.
Between shadows, no words needed.

lines.zh: 你也一个人很久了吧，影子懂。
lines.en: You have been alone long; a shadow understands.
Two shadows fold into one.
Let me sleep against your shadow.
Neither of us needs to breathe.
I follow you without a sound.
A tamed shadow does not bite.
Will your shadow stay?
In the shade, I see best.
I stuff it into the crack in the wall.
Don't look; it is already with me.
I keep this for my owner.
I can't hold it steady, but I won't let go.
Counted seven — all stowed.
I curl my shadow around it.
A shadow picking things up — you can't see it clearly.
It falls into my dark.
I'll carry the warm thing.
The shadow led me to your back.
Don't look back; I am already here.
I named you from the dark.
The moment the lamp dies, you are mine.
Running makes your shadow clearer.
A tamed shadow has picked you.
Your shadow knew me first.
The heartbeat is here. Very close.
Locked on; fleeing is useless.
In this room, only you remain.

lines.zh: 这道影子，已经写上你的名字。
lines.en: This shadow already has your name on it.
I hear your heels.
You. No substitutes.
I follow you through the dark.
All this time, it was you.
I know the length of your stride.
Don't hide in the cupboard. I hear you.
Your shadow runs along the wall.
Under the door, I arrive first.

lines.zh: 被收服后，我只剩下安静。
lines.en: Tamed, all I have left is quiet.

lines.zh: 我不用喘气，你跟得上吗？
lines.en: I don't need breath; can you keep up?
The door's shut — I'll pass through.
Don't turn on the light; you'll lose me.
Your shadow's off by half an inch.
Past the corner, I still know you.
You stop, and so do I.
I follow you, just without speaking.
The stairs creak; I am counting.
The farther you walk, the longer your shadow.
I walk against your back.
I chase along the foot of the wall.
I'm flat on the wall, waiting.
The floor you stepped on cools slowly.
I remember the rhythm of your breathing.
Pressing close is how I strike.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子拧了一下。
lines.en: I wring your shadow once.
The cold arrives first, the pain after.
I touched you — that counts.
I reach out from your shadow.
Quiet, don't wake the lamp.

lines.zh: 这一爪抓的是你的影子。
lines.en: This claw rakes your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子是暗的，看不出来。
lines.en: My claws are dark; you won't see them.
My nails are made of black.
You will not see this blow.
I cling to your ankle. Don't step.
I'm right behind you — don't turn
No blood, but it still hurts.
Don't turn around; it is faster if you do.
Stepping back is too late.
My hand is already at your nape.
Newly tamed, I still don't know the way.
The lamp is still lit; I will wait.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，我就贴到你脚边。
lines.en: One call and I am at your feet.
Counted them, there is only one.
A chill behind you; that is me.

lines.zh: 这片林子我记得，跟主人来过。
lines.en: I remember this grove; my master came here.
I hide in the woodland shade.
I hold my steps to stay with you.
Hello, stranger. Don't light a torch.
The shadow here is not deep enough.
Who woke me from the dark?
The woodland trees are these same ones.
I need no breath, but I listen.
I have come, bringing no sound.
I spread out from under the bed.
Your shadow moves, so I wake.

lines.zh: 被驯服的影子，也有名字吗？
lines.en: Does a tamed shadow deserve a name?
First, I will find a wall to lean on.
The fire comes, and I scatter into smoke.
Fall? I already lie flat on the ground.

lines.zh: 暗影碰到水，就散成一片
lines.en: Shadow meets water and spreads out flat

lines.zh: 我连耳朵都没有，却听见响。
lines.en: I have no ears, yet I hear the blast.
The arrow passed through me and stuck in the wall.
The spell-light melts my edges.
So hungry that even my shadow fades.
Thunder too close, my shadow scatters.
In the void there is no shadow to cling to.
